Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

technical_decisions: Surface phải tồn tại dưới dạng exact Geom_Surface/TopoDS_Face (degree/knots/weights nếu NURBS), không thay bằng mesh approximation.
Loft/sweep/trim phân biệt rail/profile orientation; p-curves UV, parameter domains và seam trên periodic surface.
Test BRepCheck_Analyzer, closure intentional open/solid và proper exception error transaction rollback.

input.command: Edge Planar And Patch Surface Workflows
input.purpose: surface from boundaries and planar loops

positive.setup: Create the geometry and select the inputs required by: surface from boundaries and planar loops
positive.expected: Surface/UV parameter ranges and trim orientation preserved, BRep validity checked; tessellation alone is not enough.

negative.setup: Use degenerate wire, null shape, zero/negative radius/height or impossible tolerance appropriate to Edge Planar And Patch Surface Workflows
negative.expected: Explicit domain error; document IDs, BRep cache, selection and undo journal unchanged

invariants: No success with only tessellation when an exact BRep is required
Do not infer success from an unrun test

golden_test_design.negative_assertions: Invalid/degenerate shape or incompatible selections for Edge Planar And Patch Surface Workflows must produce typed error and atomic rollback.
